title: Wonderful tour for all ages
text:
We had a fantastic private tour of the Royal Alcázar with Sofia and would highly recommend her!

From the very first contact, Sofia was incredibly friendly, helpful and organised, making everything straightforward, including arranging and purchasing our entrance tickets.

The tour itself was excellent value for money. Sofia was knowledgeable and engaging, bringing the history of the Alcázar to life in a way that was genuinely interesting rather than overwhelming or overly academic. title: Excellent Private Alcázar Tour with Sofia
text:
We had a wonderful experience with Sofia Ventura on our private tour of the Alcázar in Seville. She was extremely knowledgeable, friendly, and made the tour both interesting and enjoyable. We learned so much about the Alcázar and its history and had a great time throughout.
We would highly recommend Sofia to anyone visiting Seville and looking for a knowledgeable and engaging private guide. Thank you, Sofia, for making our visit to the Alcázar such a memorable experience!

title: Lovely morning at the Alcazar
text:
We are a couple from the USA and had the pleasure of visiting the Real Alcázar with Sofia for a private tour. She is a knowledgeable guide, speaks perfect English, and what sets her apart in my book is that she clearly takes great joy in making sure that her guests have an excellent experience during their whole visit—not just her tour.

This experience was great value for money (including skipping the line), and we whole heartedly recommend her!
